CBSE • CLASS 10 • MATHEMATICS

Mathematics — Syllabus

Standard (041) and Basic (241) share this syllabus; Basic tests the same topics at a lower difficulty. Unit marks are from the official CBSE Class X curriculum.

#ChapterUnitWeightage
1Real NumbersI · Number Systems6 marks
2PolynomialsII · Algebra4–5 marks
3Pair of Linear Equations in Two VariablesII · Algebra5–6 marks
4Quadratic EquationsII · Algebra5–7 marks
5Arithmetic ProgressionsII · Algebra5–6 marks
6TrianglesIV · Geometry9–10 marks
7Coordinate GeometryIII · Coordinate Geometry6 marks
8Introduction to TrigonometryV · Trigonometry7–8 marks
9Some Applications of TrigonometryV · Trigonometry4–5 marks
10CirclesIV · Geometry5–6 marks
11Areas Related to CirclesVI · Mensuration4–5 marks
12Surface Areas and VolumesVI · Mensuration5–6 marks
13StatisticsVII · Statistics and Probability7–8 marks
14ProbabilityVII · Statistics and Probability3–4 marks

Removed from the syllabus

  • Constructions (old Chapter 11) — removed from the Class X book entirely.
  • Areas Related to Circles: only sectors and segments of a circle remain; the rest of the old chapter was trimmed.

Prescribed books

  • Mathematics — Textbook for Class X, NCERT (primary; every board question traces back here)
  • Mathematics Exemplar Problems for Class X, NCERT (for the harder 4- and 5-mark questions)
  • Laboratory Manual — Mathematics, secondary stage, NCERT (for the 5-mark lab activity in IA)
